calculators/epf-calculator.title: EPF Calculator
calculators/epf-calculator.description: Calculate retirement savings from EPF by inputting current age, basic salary, contribution percentages, and expected retirement age — delivering precise corpus projections that empower informed decisions on voluntary contributions and financial security planning.

calculators/epf-calculator-v1.title: EPF Calculator V1
calculators/epf-calculator-v1.description: An enhanced EPF calculator that accepts inputs like present EPF balance, monthly contributions, salary growth, ages, and interest rate — projecting:

calculators/form-12bb-calculator.title: Form 12BB Calculator
calculators/form-12bb-calculator.description: Generate comprehensive Form 12BB declarations by consolidating tax-saving investments across 80C, 80D, HRA, and LTA — delivering precise deduction amounts that optimize take-home salary and eliminate tax calculation errors.

calculators/nps-calculator.title: NPS Calculator
calculators/nps-calculator.description: Calculate your NPS retirement corpus, monthly pension income, and tax benefits by inputting age, contributions, and return expectations — delivering actionable insights to future-proof your retirement strategy.

calculators/nps-calculator-v1.title: NPS Calculator V1
calculators/nps-calculator-v1.description: An enhanced NPS calculator that projects month-by-month contributions, monthly interest accrual, monthly corpus updates, and yearly summaries. Supports all NPS investment classes:

calculators/old-vs-new-regime.title: Old vs New Tax Regime
calculators/old-vs-new-regime.description: Calculate and benchmark tax obligations under both regimes with real-time slab rate application and deduction analysis — empowering strategic tax planning decisions that maximize take-home income based on individual financial profiles.

calculators/pension-calculator.title: Pension Calculator
calculators/pension-calculator.description: Calculate taxable and exempt pension amounts for commuted or uncommuted pension payments — enabling accurate tax compliance and retirement income optimization for government and private sector retirees.
